elimination.campus_nutty_mug: Peanut butter in smoothies and nuts on bowls: fails Cyrus's peanut allergy (deal-breaker).
elimination.campus_griddle_house: Greasy, butter-soaked, no vegetables: misses Brooke's no-grease and fresh preferences (two stars lost).
elimination.campus_sprout_lounge: $$ is one tier over the $ budget (one star lost), and a review confirms it is pricey for students.
elimination.campus_green_bean_cafe: Cafe, $, coffee plus fresh grain bowls and salads, light food, peanuts kept out of the kitchen. Meets every constraint.

notes: Each decoy fails on exactly one axis (allergy, grease/freshness, price), so the puzzle is clean and fair.

Maya's warning that cafes sneak peanut butter into smoothies nicely points at The Nutty Mug, and its name gives it away too. The name alone tells you it is a decoy, but the review confirms it, so you can't get it right by guessing.
Sprout Lounge's review says 'nut-free', which covers peanuts in practice. A careful player might pause over whether 'nut-free' includes peanuts, but it doesn't matter because the venue is $$.

Sandwiches (part of Brooke's pitch) aren't mentioned in any review. I treated them as an example of 'cafe lunch' and not as a separate craving. If they count on their own, no venue clearly meets them, which would be slightly unfair.
With the tags hidden, the reviews carry all the evidence and every constraint could be checked from them. Fairly easy for a level 4.
